The '''OT-9 Sentinel Droid''' was a four-legged [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. OT-9 Sentinel Droids were among the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] deployed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in defense of the [[Imperial Command Compound]] in the [[Markaran Plains]].
